cab.cambiarTema: Switch between light and dark theme

cal.sub: Base section · October 2026 · block events come in through a bridge
cal.etqTitulo: Label by course · contributed by the Assessments block

tareas.sub: Base section · 9 tasks · 3 for today · block tasks come in with their permission
tareas.t2: Review the base case of induction
tareas.t4: Put together the lab report (due Thursday 15)

ajustes.sub: No block sees the system settings; it does see the ones it contributes, and those leave with it
ajustes.temaDesc: Mimo Academics has 9. The prototype starts with 2 and the theme is a declaration.
ajustes.idiomaDesc: Affects the base and any blocks that ship a translation.
ajustes.escalaDesc: It is system-wide: raising it does not force a change in any block.
ajustes.atajosDesc: The system ones are not taken: Alt+Tab, Alt+F4 and Alt+Space stay free.
ajustes.vistaDefectoDesc: What the section opens with. It does not change what is inside.
ajustes.semanaEmpiezaDesc: Week numbering is ISO: 40 to 44 in October 2026.
ajustes.vistaAnioDesc: Show the week column in the year view too.
ajustes.mostrarEtiquetasDesc: Puts the course and its weight on every assessment in the calendar.
ajustes.calAporteNotaHtml: The Calendar section renders this layer, but the setting belongs to {bloque}: it is declared in its manifest with "seccion": "calendario". If the block is not there, this accordion is not drawn.
ajustes.prioridadDefectoDesc: The one applied when creating a task without choosing.
ajustes.mostrarHechasDesc: If you turn them off they stay saved: they just stop being listed.
ajustes.bloquesVacio: No blocks installed: the ones you install show up here and in the sidebar.
ajustes.packsNotaHtml: A pack has no screen: it installs blocks and declares their group settings ("seccion": "sistema").
ajustes.agruparDesc: Installs Study, Curriculum, Time, Grades and Notes. Right now {n} of {m}: the pack reports it, it uninstalls nothing.
ajustes.completarDesc: Installs the missing ones. Asks for a single confirmation with all permissions added up.
ajustes.canalDesc: bundled · ships with the app, no network. local and remote are decided in the contract (§10).
ajustes.almacenDesc: Everything lives on this machine. There is no external service.
ajustes.borrarDesc: Asks for confirmation and says exactly what it deletes.

modal.aviso: These buttons really install and uninstall: the state lives in your browser's local store.

toast.buscarNo: Search is not here yet: it arrives with the engine (Iteration 4).
toast.sync: Sync: local only for now (option C). There is no external service.
toast.ayuda: Help: Ctrl+K searches · Ctrl+, settings · Escape closes. Full help arrives in Iteration 4.
toast.diagnostico: Diagnostics: local store OK · bundled catalog OK · 0 broken references. Nothing to repair.
toast.visual: Visual: this control will arrive with the engine (Iteration 4).

panel.sinContexto: No context · this section does not declare panelContexto
panel.notaEstudio: Declared by the Study manifest: panelContexto. The shell renders the panel.
panel.notaAporte: Assessments contributes the course and its weight to every assessment.

sub.resumen: {semestres} semesters · {ramos} courses · {aprobados} passed · {activos} in progress · {creditos} credits passed
sub.vacio: No data yet · import the JSON backup.
sub.sinMotor: The curriculum engine is missing: this screen turns on when bloques/malla/motor.js loads.
sub.error: The curriculum could not be read. Try again.

malla.pista: Select a course to see its detail in the panel.

mapa.pista: Select a course to see its prerequisites and what it unlocks.
mapa.leyendaSel: Blue: what it needs · Amber: what it unlocks.

acc.importarAria: Import JSON · opens a curriculum backup file
acc.exportarAria: Export · curriculum summary (the full export arrives in 4e)
acc.exportarTitulo: For now it shows the summary: the download arrives in 4e

vacio.sinMotorTxt: This screen needs bloques/malla/motor.js. It retries on refresh and no data is invented.
vacio.sinDatosTxt: Import the JSON backup (format 2) to see your courses grouped by semester.
vacio.errorTit: The curriculum could not be read
vacio.errorTxt: The engine returned an error. Try again or check the imported backup.

import.sinMotor: The curriculum engine is not loaded yet: it cannot import.
import.sinImportador: bloques/malla/importar.js is missing: the file cannot be read.
import.error: The file could not be imported.
import.ok: Curriculum imported: {cursos} courses · {aprobados} passed · {activos} in progress

pie.syncTitulo: Sync: local only for now (option C)

estudio.sub: Installable block · it can be removed and the base stays whole
estudio.proxDesc: The installation is real: the block is already mounted in the frame. Its logic arrives in Iteration 4; below is the context its manifest declares.
estudio.aviso: The installation, the manifest and the permissions are the ones in the contract. The block's internal controls arrive with the engine.

generico.sub: Installable block · {naturaleza} · no screen of its own yet
generico.proxDesc: This block is already really installed: it takes its place in the sidebar and can be removed. Its screen arrives in Iteration 4.
generico.aviso: Installed and persisted · the block's logic is not part of this iteration.

academics.desc: Five academic blocks in a single order.

malla.desc: Degree curriculum: courses, semester and credits.

tiempo.desc: Stopwatch, timer, pomodoro and a session log.

apuntes.desc: Free-text notes by course or topic.

evaluaciones.desc: Puts the course and its weight on the calendar.

kit-temas-oscuros.desc: Three dark themes: midnight, black and deepsea.

tiempo.sub: Stopwatch, timer and pomodoro, with a log of where your time goes.

reloj.pistaCrono: Counts the time you put in. Pause it when you want to log it.

destino.titulo: What are you spending the time on?
destino.marcador: A course, a project, a client…
destino.ayuda: Whatever you write here goes on every session you log.

aviso.nadaQueRegistrar: The clock hasn't reached a minute: there is nothing to log.
aviso.minutosInvalidos: Type the minutes you want to log.
aviso.tempFinRegistro: The timer is done · {min} session logged
aviso.pomoDescanso: You are on a break: it is not logged as work.
aviso.noGuarda: The state could not be saved
aviso.importFallo: Could not import: the text is not a valid Time backup.
aviso.respaldoVacio: The box is empty: paste a backup or press Export first.

respaldo.marcador: Press Export to get the backup, or paste one here to import it.
respaldo.ayuda: Export and import use the same box. Import adds whatever the backup brings; it does not erase what is already there.

tiempo.faltaMotor: The block's engine is missing (bloques/tiempo/motor.js): no invented data is drawn.
